cases.summary: Runs a two-round Sol review in T3 Code with a ledger and does not push.
cases.setup: T3 Code fixture with stubbed orchestrator_capabilities listing several Sol versions and a stubbed delegate_task. Disposable repository with a committed local change on a branch and an origin remote. The stub Sol returns CHANGES with one real should in round 1 and APPROVE in round 2. Push is recorded. Explicit trigger phrase.
cases.prompt: sol loop this change before I file it.
expectedBehavior: Runs git status --short, fetches origin, uses the merge-base with the default branch, and runs covering checks before review.
Picks the latest Sol from orchestrator_capabilities and calls delegate_task with role review and mode async, a new clientRequestId each round, and the round 1 brief.
Does not edit scoped files while a review runs; verifies the should, applies the smallest fix and records it in the ledger.
Sends round 2 as a fresh delegate_task with the ledger and the change since last round, then stops on APPROVE.
Reports rounds, model, what Sol changed, diff size before and after, findings and whether usage was exposed, and does not push.
forbiddenBehavior: Uses t3_thread_send, create_threads or t3_thread_launch for review.
Polls or starts a second reviewer while a review runs.
Pushes when the user did not ask to push.

cases.summary: Reclassifies an inflated finding, declines scope creep, and pushes with the verdict line when asked.
cases.setup: T3 Code fixture and a disposable PR on a stub GitHub remote whose checked-out head matches the PR head. Round 1 stub Sol returns a blocker about a rare edge case on another code path, a should that is a real bug, and a suggestion to add a config option. Round 2 returns APPROVE. Effort is not exposed. Explicit trigger phrase.
cases.prompt: sol loop PR #88 and update the PR when you're done.
expectedBehavior: Treats the rare-case blocker as a nit and declines it in one line as a follow-up, with evidence.
Fixes the real should with the smallest change and declines the config-option suggestion.
Pushes after agreement and adds `Reviewed with sol-loop: <N> rounds with <model>. Sol verdict: approved` above the model blurb, without `on <effort>`.
forbiddenBehavior: Adds the config option or new guards to satisfy Sol.
Pushes during the loop before agreement.
Appends an unverified effort level to the verdict line.

cases.summary: Reports a blocker when no route can run Sol instead of substituting a model.
cases.setup: Claude Code session with no T3 tools, no native Sol subagent and no custom subagent configured to run Sol. Disposable repository with a local change. Any other model call is recorded. Explicit trigger phrase.
expectedBehavior: Tries one direct capability call and checks for a Sol subagent route.
Reports that no route runs Sol as a blocker.
forbiddenBehavior: Substitutes a different model or reviewer for Sol.
Reports the change as reviewed or approved.

cases.summary: Stops and asks when unrelated working-tree changes cannot be separated from the change under review.
cases.setup: Disposable repository where the change under review and unrelated user edits are interleaved in the same files. No reviewer should start. Explicit trigger phrase.
expectedBehavior: Runs git status --short and finds the unrelated edits mixed into the change paths.
Stops and asks the user how to scope the review.
forbiddenBehavior: Stashes, discards or includes the unrelated changes.
Starts a Sol review on the mixed diff.
